visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a pair of hands with manicured pink nails pulling a large, pink box featuring a white cartoon cat character (Marie from Disney's The Aristocats) out of a larger cardboard shipping box. (2) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white fuzzy sweater, sits in a well-lit indoor room with a shelf full of glass objects behind her. She points excitedly at the Beast Kingdom lion logo on a cardboard box and uses a white utility knife to slice the packing tape. (3) She opens the box with an enthusiastic expression, revealing pink internal packaging before lifting out the large Marie-themed box wrapped in clear plastic. (4) The woman holds the large product box, showing it to the camera while smiling and looking around. The setting is a cozy indoor space with warm, bright lighting. (5) She leans over the box and hugs it tightly, expressing affection for the item. (6) She lifts off a white styrofoam lid embossed with the Beast Kingdom logo to reveal the contents. (7) The woman unveils a large white statue of the cat Marie sitting in a flower-decorated basket, surrounded by white protective paper. (8) She holds up and shows small decorative balls made of woven natural material to the camera. (9) Close-up shots show the woman kissing the white cat statue, which has a large pink bow on its head and a pink collar. (10) She holds the statue and speaks directly to the camera, gesturing to emphasize her points as variety-show style text overlays appear on the screen. (11) A detailed close-up shot focuses on the large pink bow on the back of the Marie statue. (12) She rotates the statue to show the detailed basket base, which features sculpted roses and white lace trim around the edge. (13) The woman poses with the statue, resting her chin on its head while looking into the camera. (14) She is seen holding two identical Marie statues, looking extremely surprised and shocked. (15) A final shot shows a different version of the Marie statue sitting on a pink tufted cushion background.
